blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Many visual tracking methods use rejection mechanisms to suppress unreliable predictions. However, these mechanisms can also reject correctly localized candidates, leaving useful information unused. We investigate how to identify and recover these candidates while preserving native accepted outputs and candidate coordinates. To this end, we propose P-SRM (Post-rejection Selective Recovery Method), which combines spatial responses, past accepted states, and native decision margins to reassess candidates and selectively restore reliable predictions. We evaluate P-SRM on six trackers and four datasets spanning category-specific, point, and generic object tracking. Across all nine configurations, P-SRM improves rejected-candidate ranking and overall tracking performance. These results show that post-rejection verification can identify and recover useful predictions discarded by native rejection, demonstrating the value of reusing rejected information.
Project repository: https://github.com/PalestyHR/P-SRM .
blocks.zh:
许多视觉跟踪方法使用拒绝机制压制不可靠的预测. 然而,这些机制也可以正确地拒绝本地化候选人,使有用的信息得不到利用。 我们调查如何确定和收回这些候选人,同时保留当地接受的产出和候选人的坐标。 为此,我们提出P-SRM(拒绝后选择恢复方法),这种方法将空间反应、过去接受的状态和本土决定幅度结合起来,重新评估候选人,有选择地恢复可靠的预测。 我们通过6个跟踪器和4个数据集对P-SRM进行评估,这些数据集涵盖特定类别、点和通用对象跟踪。 在所有9个配置中,P-SRM改进了被拒绝的candidate排名和总体跟踪性能. 这些结果显示,拒绝后核查可以识别和恢复因本土拒绝而丢弃的有用预测,表明重新使用被拒绝信息的价值.
项目存放处:https://github.com/PalestyHR/P-SRM 。 。 。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Visual tracking estimates target locations across video frames. Many tracking methods use explicit rejection mechanisms to filter unreliable predictions. The TrackNet family targets small, fast-moving sports objects, including tennis balls and shuttlecocks. It decodes positions from heatmaps and suppresses weak responses before reporting locations [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] . TAP-Net and TAPIR track specified points on physical surfaces and use visibility or localization uncertainty to judge prediction validity [ 4 , 5 ] . KCF locates generic objects using correlation-filter responses [ 6 ] ; the implementation used here accepts or rejects predictions based on the response peak. These mechanisms serve their respective tasks by separating accepted outputs from rejected candidates.
blocks.zh: 视像跟踪估计跨视频帧目标位置. 许多跟踪方法使用明确的拒绝机制来过滤不可靠的预测. TrackNet家族以小型,快速移动的运动物体为目标,包括网球和穿梭雀. 它从热映射中解码位置,并在报告位置[1,2,3]前抑制弱响应. TAP-Net和TAPIR跟踪在物理表面指定了点,并利用可见度或本地化不确定性判断预测有效性[4,5]. KCF 使用关联过滤响应定位通用对象 [6];这里使用的执行接受或拒绝基于响应峰值的预测. 这些机制通过将已接受的产出与被拒绝的候选人分开来完成各自的任务。

blocks.en: Native rejection, however, does not necessarily imply incorrect localization. For example, a tracker may correctly locate a fast-moving shuttlecock in a blurred frame, yet withhold that position because its confidence score or heatmap peak falls below the threshold. Recovering this correctly localized but rejected candidate can restore a missing output. Yet rejected candidates also include mislocalizations and predictions made when the target is invisible. The key challenge is therefore to distinguish correctly localized candidates from these actual errors.
blocks.zh: 然而,土著拒绝并不一定意味着不正确的本地化。 例如,一个跟踪器可能在模糊的框中正确定位一个快速移动的穿梭孔雀,但因它的置信分数或热映射峰低于阈值而扣住这个位置. 恢复正确本地化但被拒绝的候选人可以恢复缺失的产出。 然而,被否决的候选人也包括在目标看不见时被误位和预测。 因此,关键的挑战是正确区分本地化候选人与这些实际错误。

blocks.en: Related work addresses the distinction between reliable predictions and errors. Confidence calibration aligns predicted probabilities with correctness likelihood [ 7 ] . Mask Scoring R-CNN and MFTIQ estimate the quality of masks and flow correspondences, respectively [ 8 , 9 ] . ByteTrack uses low-score detections through association [ 10 ] , while SelectiveNet jointly learns prediction and rejection [ 11 ] . These approaches aim to improve confidence reliability, quality assessment, or prediction association and selection. We instead study candidate verification after native rejection: can the original tracker’s evidence identify and recover correctly localized candidates while preserving native accepted outputs and candidate coordinates?
blocks.zh: 相关工作涉及可靠预测与错误之间的区别. 置信度校准将预测概率与正确性概率校准 [7]. 口罩扫描R-CNN和MFTIQ分别估计口罩和流信的质量[8,9]. ByteTrack通过关联使用低分数检测[10],而SelectiveNet联合学习预测和拒绝[11]. 这些办法旨在改善信任的可靠性、质量评估或预测的联系和选择。 相反,我们研究了本地拒绝后的候选人核实:原始追踪者的证据能否在保留本地接受的产出和候选人协调的同时确定并正确恢复本地候选人?

blocks.en: To answer this question, we propose P-SRM (Post-rejection Selective Recovery Method). P-SRM combines adapted spatial evidence, motion history, and native decision margins to reassess rejected candidates and selectively readmit reliable predictions (Fig. 1 ). Our experiments confirm that native rejection does discard correctly localized candidates that can be identified and recovered. The results further show that recovering these candidates can also improve tracking performance.
blocks.zh: 为了回答这个问题,我们提出了P-SRM(拒绝后选择性回收方法)。 P-SRM结合了经过调整的空间证据,运动历史和本土决定幅度,重新评估被否决的候选人,并有选择地重新投放可靠的预测(图1). 我们的实验证实,本地拒绝确实抛弃了能够识别和回收的正确本地化候选人。 调查结果进一步显示,收回这些候选人还可以改善跟踪业绩。

blocks.en: Overall, our contributions include: (i) we identify correctly localized predictions excluded by native rejection, distinguishing admission errors from localization failures; (ii) we develop P-SRM to recover these candidates while preserving native accepted outputs and candidate coordinates; and (iii) we validate its identification and tracking benefits across six trackers and four datasets.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,我们的贡献包括:(一) 我们正确确定被本地拒绝排除在外的本地化预测,区分录取错误和本地化失败;(二) 我们开发P-SRM,以收回这些候选人,同时保留本地接受的产出和候选人坐标;(三) 我们验证它在六个跟踪器和四个数据集中的识别和跟踪效益。

blocks.en: 3 Experiments and Results
blocks.zh: 3 实验和结果

blocks.en: 3.1 Benchmarks and evaluation protocol
blocks.zh: 3.1 基准和评价协议

blocks.en: We evaluate P-SRM in category-specific, point, and generic object tracking, covering six trackers and four datasets (Table 1 ) [ 13 , 4 , 14 ] . TrackNet and point-tracking configurations use source data for fitting and calibration, followed by evaluation on separate splits. KCF uses video-grouped five-fold evaluation on OTB2013 with supplementary visibility annotations.
blocks.zh: 我们按特定类别、点数和通用对象跟踪评估P-SRM,涵盖6个跟踪器和4个数据集(表1)[13、4、14]。 TrackNet和点跟踪配置使用源数据进行安装和校准,然后对单独的拆分进行评价. KCF在OTB2013上使用视频分组的五倍评价,并附有补充可见度说明.

blocks.en: Native predictions are fixed. P-SRM is fitted and OOF-calibrated for each tracker configuration. Main results average seeds 42, 3407, and 8008; cue ablations in Table 2 use seed 42.
blocks.zh: 原生预测是固定的. P-SRM为每个跟踪器配置配备并进行OOF校准. 主要结果平均种子42、3407和8008;表2的示意图使用种子42。

blocks.en: AP r is the primary metric for identifying correct candidates within the native rejection set. Final tracking metrics measure the benefits realized after selective admission. Accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 pool events; Average Jaccard (AJ) and Occlusion Accuracy (OA) average videos.
blocks.zh: AP r是确定本土拒绝中正确候选人的主要衡量标准. 最后跟踪指标衡量选择性录取后实现的效益。 精度,精度,召回和F1池事件;平均Jaccard(AJ)和Occulsion精确度(OA)平均视频.

blocks.en: 3.2 Rejected-candidate identification and recovery
blocks.zh: 3.2 被拒绝的指定身份和追回

blocks.en: Table 1 shows that every native rejection set contains correctly localized candidates. P-SRM identifies and recovers these candidates without changing their coordinates, improving AP r across all nine configurations. The 95% paired-bootstrap confidence intervals for pooled F1 gains over Native also lie entirely above zero in every configuration.
blocks.zh: 表1显示,每套本地拒签申请都包含正确的本地化候选人。 P-SRM在不改变坐标的情况下识别和回收这些候选人,改进了所有9个配置的AP r. 组合F1收益超过土著收益的95%的配对-bootstrap置信间隔在每个配置中也完全高于零。

blocks.en: Even in configurations with low correct-candidate recovery rates, AP r improves substantially. This finding highlights the value of assessing rejected-candidate quality separately from the final admission decision.
blocks.zh: 即使在配置中,正确的扫描恢复率很低,AP r 也大幅改善. 这一结论突出表明,在作出最后接纳决定的同时,评估被拒绝的提名人的质量是有价值的。

blocks.en: 3.3 Ablation and sensitivity analysis
blocks.zh: 3.3 校准和敏感性分析

blocks.en: To assess the need for full P-SRM, we compare simpler recovery schemes using quality (Q), history (H), and native margin (M): M, Q, M+H, Q+H, and Q+M (Table 2 ). M uses only the native scalar margin through a one-dimensional logistic readout calibrated on source-domain OOF scores. For both trackers, the final fitted mapping is increasing, making its admission rule equivalent to native-score thresholding while preserving native accepted outputs. All schemes share candidates, source partitions, and calibration rules, with separately calibrated thresholds.
blocks.zh: 为了评估全面的P-SRM的必要性,我们用质量(Q)、历史(H)和本土边距(M):M、Q、M+H、QQH和QQM(表2)来比较更简单的回收计划。 M只通过对源域OOF分数进行一维物流读取校准使用原生的scalar比值. 对两个跟踪者来说,最终的匹配绘图正在增加,使其录取规则相当于本土分数阈值,同时保留本地接受的产出。 所有方案都共享候选者,源分区,校准规则,并有单独的校准阈值.

blocks.en: Table 2: Cue ablations (pp); CIs: 10,000 paired video bootstraps with fixed models/thresholds. Δ ​ t \Delta t : five-run mean end-to-end change (ms/frame, RTX 4090).
blocks.zh: 表2:Cue bloods (pp); CIs:10,000对带固定型号/阈值的视频靴子. t\Delta t:5运行的中间端对端变化(ms/frame,RTX 4090).

blocks.en: Table 3: Hyperparameter sensitivity analysis. Defaults: ( λ a , κ , Λ ) = ( 0.5 , 0.6 , 1 ) (\lambda_{a},\kappa,\Lambda)=(0.5,0.6,1) . Seed: 3407.
blocks.zh: 表3:超参数灵敏度分析。 默认 : ( , κ, κ) = (0.5, 0.6, 1) (\lambda_{a},\kappa,\Lambda) = (0.5, 0.6, 1). 种子: 3407.

blocks.en: Full outperforms M and M+H in ranking and recovery for both point trackers, demonstrating the value of spatial quality information not fully exploited by native scores and history. Comparisons with Q, Q+H, and Q+M further support the cues’ complementary value for ranking. It should be clarified that the complementary value of these cues for ranking does not imply higher final tracking metrics in every setting. Because trackers process candidates differently, the contribution of the same cue may vary across settings, allowing some simpler combinations to achieve better results in certain cases. We nevertheless adopt Full for its applicability across tracking settings and demonstrated identification and tracking gains.
blocks.zh: 两个点数跟踪器在排名和回收方面完全超越M和M+H,表明空间质量信息的价值未被本土分数和历史充分利用. 与Q、QQH和QQM的比较进一步支持了提示对排名的补充价值。 应当澄清的是,这些提示对排名的补充价值并不意味着在每个场合都有更高的最终跟踪指标。 由于追踪器对候选人的处理方式不同,同一提示的贡献可能因设置而异,在某些情况下允许一些更简单的组合来达到更好的效果. 然而,我们完全采用这一方法,使其适用于各种跟踪环境,并显示出识别和跟踪成果。

blocks.en: We additionally assess sensitivity to training hyperparameters by varying one parameter at a time in TAP-Net/Kinetics and TrackNetV3/Shuttlecock. Tracking performance remains broadly stable across the tested settings, with consistent gains over Native (Table 3 ).
blocks.zh: 我们还在TAP-Net/Kinetics和TrackNetV3/Shuttlecock中,一次用不同的参数评估训练超参数的敏感性。 在整个已测试环境中,跟踪业绩仍然大体稳定,与土著相比,不断提高(表3)。

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en: P-SRM demonstrates that correctly localized predictions can be recovered after native rejection. Across multiple trackers and datasets, this improves candidate identification and tracking performance, establishing post-rejection verification as a practical way to reuse existing predictions.
blocks.zh: P-SRM显示,本地拒绝后可以恢复正确的局部预测. 在整个多个跟踪器和数据集中,这改善了候选人的识别和跟踪性能,建立了拒绝后核查,作为重新利用现有预测的实际方法。

blocks.en: COMPLIANCE WITH ETHICAL STANDARDS
blocks.zh: 遵守道德标准

blocks.en: All experiments use existing, publicly available datasets: Shuttlecock, RacketVision, TAP-Vid Kinetics, and OTB2013. We use dataset-provided annotations, including the corrected Shuttlecock Test labels released with TrackNetV3. For OTB2013, we retain the original bounding-box annotations and add supplementary target-visibility labels. This study involves no new participant recruitment or video recording.
blocks.zh: 所有实验都使用现有的,可公开获取的数据集:Shuttlecock, Racket Vision, TAP-Vid Kinetics,和OTB2013. 我们使用数据集提供的说明,包括更正的Shuttlecock Test标签随TrackNetV3发布. 对于OTB2013,我们保留了原来的边框说明,并增加了补充的目标可见性标签. 这项研究不涉及征聘新的参与者或录象。
